items.title: Automated GitHub → Google Sheets Projection & Reconciliation

proposal.title: PROPOSAL 01 — Automated GitHub to Google Sheets Projection and Reconciliation

items.why: Remove manual GitHub-to-Sheets duplication while keeping GitHub canonical and Sheets a controlled human projection/input surface.
items.proposed_first_gate: Human approval for one bounded generated-tab pilot with stable keys, provider readback and reconciliation.
items.current_boundary: Do not implement automatically. Resume only after explicit approval.

items.title: Secure user/company-specific project visibility
items.short_title: Authenticated project access and company permissions

proposal.title: Security architecture decision — recommended Supabase Auth + Postgres RLS for a future private project portal

items.why: Allow a signed-in person to see ONLY projects permitted by verified company membership, project assignment and role, including cross-company and exceptional access.
items.recommendation: When real per-user access is approved, prefer Supabase Auth + PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) for user identity, company memberships, project grants and server-enforced per-project reads. Treat Supabase as the authorization runtime, not a replacement for A7, Git version control or Drive evidence storage.
items.proposed_architecture: A7 semantic project/company identities and Operations project-master IDs → authenticated user identity → company_memberships + project_access rules in private Postgres → RLS-filtered API/view → authorized map and project page. Google Drive file access must also be checked separately.
security_invariants: Never rely on URL parameters, JavaScript hiding, or static GitHub Pages CSV/JSON as access control.
Private project facts and user/company membership lists must NOT be shipped in the public Pages artifact/repository.
Default-deny at the data/API layer. Validate every project row against logged-in user identity and grants.
Separate public marketing/project-map data from authenticated operational/engineering views.
Use existing A7 identities/route references; do not build a duplicate project identity or authority plane.
items.alternatives: Neon/PostgreSQL + separate authentication/API service is viable but requires more integration; Supabase is the default candidate if Auth + RLS + API in one managed stack is desirable. Confirm plan, pricing, hosting region, integration and security needs at decision time.
items.when_to_build: Start only when distinct user accounts must have different protected project datasets, or authenticated write workflows are approved. For a public convenience filter such as showing Fishtail first, no database is required.
items.proposed_first_gate: Human approves required personas, companies, project-grants matrix, privacy classification and a private proof-of-concept scope.
items.current_boundary: Deferred. Current map scope/filter is public convenience only, not a secure access boundary.

items.title: Control Towers and Main Library automated GitHub synchronization
items.short_title: A9 control index refresh and complete migration

proposal.title: Source-linked directory pilot and future deterministic Drive-to-GitHub mirror

items.why: The Controls page is a static versioned index; changes to Drive Main Library and control tower sources do not automatically update it.
items.recommendation: Use a provider-authenticated scheduled sync to read source Drive stable IDs and version/revisions, compare to the GitHub control-directory JSON, and update it only after source and write readback. Keep unchanged Drive originals; migrate full Main/Local catalogues only after verified PK/FK/cursor lineage.
items.when_to_build: After accepting the initial Control Towers subpage, verifying the full A9 control inventory and selecting an authenticated Drive sync method.
security_invariants: Do not replace stable Drive IDs or erase historical PRE/POST or artifact relationships.
Do not call the index real-time synchronized or claim the Main Library is fully migrated until all scope/edge/cursor readbacks pass.
items.proposed_first_gate: Inventory full Main AddressLookup and eligible control sources; build one-control drift-detection pilot.
items.current_boundary: Full automatic refresh and wholesale A9 Main/Local migration are not implemented.

items.title: A9-CWO two-channel Discord daily intake activation
items.why: Two-channel Discord message/attachment data now exists in a provider-verified partial Drive receipt. Media fidelity is unresolved and must not be counted as a completed daily backup.
items.recommendation: C04 is a strictly bounded one-JPEG source-CDN derivative pilot, not bulk attachment recovery or proof of original fidelity. In a valid C01/C03 runtime, execute C04 to archive only one image in private DERIVATIVE_BYTES + immutable sidecar with exact provider readback. Avoid running full C02 while original-byte mismatch persists. Update project-group coverage before proposing new channels.
items.when_to_build: Use the next authorized Colab execution, review per-source media mismatch diagnostics and verify new Drive receipt.
items.proposed_first_gate: Completed user-reported C03 sample; next make original-vs-provider-derivative classification explicit, test one small targeted recovery without advancing incomplete source cursor, and record evidence/receipt before broad media retry.
items.current_boundary: Oct 9: 174 Discord messages reconciled into eight Daily Ops project records, with 7 new Discord evidence admissions; 11 Slack trackers/rollups sent with readback. 749 original byte mismatches remain. Notebook revision 20261009-007 includes optional single-file C04 provenance-labelled derivative pilot, NOT YET EXECUTED. Await user C01/C03/C04 then sanitized receipt; no C02 rerun.
security_invariants: Read only the two specified Discord parent channels plus currently active child threads; never crawl the whole server
No credential stored in GitHub, Drive source JSONL or a notebook output
No provider cursor advancement on failed raw or attachment archival
Do not claim provider capture DONE until first real Discord API and Drive readback

items.title: Narayani source-version certification and A9 Local/Main closeout

proposal.title: Source import manifest — 13 files copied, 16 CWO resources linked

items.why: Maintain clear, verified lineage between the external Rambazar/Narayani source account and the governed kaksaveksaka project while preventing legacy 2025 models from being mistaken for approved 2026 drawings.
items.proposed_first_gate: Confirm engineer-approved drawing/model revision IDs and independent SHA-256 source-vs-copy equality; register source→copy edges in the existing project file index, owning Local Library and Main Library without duplicates.
items.current_boundary: Never delete old source or replace revised 2026 drawings without engineer QC. No direct claim of byte-hash match or engineering design approval.

items.title: Multi-provider archive completeness and optional AI query indexes
items.why: Keep one durable, lossless private provider archive and derive efficient AI search indexes without misclassifying missing Discord originals, archived threads or private Slack history as complete.
items.proposed_first_gate: Certify provider raw source coverage/cursors and 749 Discord original byte mismatches; only then pilot rebuildable SQLite/DuckDB and reversible compressed partitions on private verified data. Treat Parquet as optional.
items.current_boundary: Private evidence stays in Drive. No original overwrite, false archive certification or public raw-message publication.
